name: composition-module-tests
description: Cross-module build-output assertion suite. Not a Hugo module: this directory holds the one fixture that imports modules/seo, modules/agent-readiness, modules/search, modules/pwa, modules/og-image and modules/url-retirement TOGETHER, and asserts what only a site holding several of them can show -- that a single merged [outputs] table publishes every module's documents from one build, that a card og-image composes reaches og:image through the seo module's generated-image hook, and that url-retirement's URL manifest lists exactly the documents this build published, using publication answers the modules owning each format supply and registrations the modules owning each page-less URL make. It carries no dependencies -- node --test, node:assert and node:zlib are enough -- so it needs no npm install of its own.
